name: agent-skills
description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A packaged set of senior-engineer habits and quality checks that an AI coding assistant follows automatically on every task, instead of cutting corners.
buyer: An engineering lead at a product company who wants their team's AI coding agents to consistently follow code-quality and testing standards without manual policing.
business_use_cases: A SaaS company installs it so every AI-generated pull request already includes tests and follows the team's quality gates.
A dev agency uses it across client projects as a selling point: 'our AI-assisted work meets production standards, not just demo quality.'
A platform engineering team adapts it into an internal standard that onboarding engineers and AI agents both follow.

money_ideas.idea: Publish an advanced or company-specific version of the skill pack and sell it to engineering teams as a quality-standards product.

steal_this: Free, open developer tooling that mainly builds the author's reputation and following — worth copying the format for your own niche skill pack, not reselling as-is.
